title: Signs of a hardware problem and when to stop pushing

videos.script: The last lesson was a method with no facts in it. This one is the facts: what a failing machine actually does, part by part, and which of those means stop now. {{facts}} Hardware faults are worth a lesson of their own for one reason. Almost all of them imitate software: a slow machine, a crash, a program that will not open. So people treat them as software for weeks, while the part that is actually failing gets worse. {{imitate}} Heat, the disk, the memory, the power and the screen. Each one has a signature, and three of them have a symptom that means put it down and copy your files off before anything else. {{five}} If nothing else in this lesson stays with you, keep this. A machine that is broken is one thing. A machine that is about to take your work with it is another.
